headline: Uganda EAC Trade Deficit Widens to $809 Million on Surge in Imports
summary: Uganda's trade deficit with the East African Community widened to $809 million in August 2026 as imports from Kenya and Tanzania outstripped exports.
why: Trade balance figures are a key macroeconomic indicator reflecting a country's net exports and currency demand within regional trade blocks.

impacts.name: Uganda
impacts.why: A widening trade deficit indicates higher net import outflows within the regional economic community.
